summary: Comprehensive test suite spanning unit tests (cartesianProduct, include/exclude/parseConfig), CLI integration (subprocess invocation, argument parsing, file I/O), workflow structure validation (YAML parsing, actionlint), and end-to-end testing via act. All major requirements tested: matrix expansion, include/exclude semantics, maxParallel/failFast/maxSize configuration, error handling, and GitHub Actions pipeline validation. Minor gaps: stdin reading in generate.ts not tested, some act output assertions are marker-pattern-dependent and could be fragile, --help flag not tested in subprocess. Good cleanup and isolation; TDD methodology evident. Would catch most regressions.
